# Quantum Hadamard Powers

> Heralded normalized coordinatewise powers of quantum states under reversible, ordinary forward-only, and separately budgeted copy and reflection access.

## Reading choices

- For the story, read the overview, extraction and benchmarks.
- For the theorem, read the model, extraction and spectral filter in order.
- For implementation choices, read the spectral filter and resource account together.
- For self-directed study, use the bridge beside the milestone map.

## Scope of the claims

- A clean source yields a coherent powered state. Reversible access to a purification yields a joint powered state, whose label reduction is the normalized entrywise power of the reduced input.
- The earlier collective extraction is exact on its ideal success branch. Finite spectral filtering contributes the stated approximation error.
- The unknown-moment instance bound is expected query cost. The dimension-based bound gives a hard budget with the residual failure probability included in the accuracy guarantee.
- The evaluator lower bound applies to the measured square law. The Haar lower bound concerns reversible coherent square preparation. The forward-only lower bound ranges over compatible unitary completions, and the separate reflection result fixes a known magnitude profile and a supplied-copy budget.
- Oracle query savings do not give a gate-time claim without a source-cost and routing comparison.
